# Ecocee

> Ecocee is an AI and embedded systems engineering company in Kerala, India. It builds custom AI agents, private AI infrastructure, embedded and IoT hardware, and business software, and it publishes Kode, an open source programming language.

Ecocee takes ideas that need to become real and engineers them end to end: the intelligence (AI agents and models), the software around it, and the connected hardware where a product needs it. Work is done for businesses in Kerala and across India. Enquiries start with a short project form on the website.

## What Ecocee builds

- Custom AI agents for businesses: customer enquiries and lead handling over WhatsApp, email and website chat; office assistants for meeting summaries, document analysis, scheduling and internal knowledge; warehouse agents for inventory tracking, reorder automation, supplier coordination, anomaly detection and demand forecasting.
- Private AI infrastructure: AI that runs on infrastructure the customer controls.
- Embedded systems, edge computing devices and IoT: custom firmware and hardware with on-device AI, cloud integration and remote monitoring.
- PCB design and rapid prototyping.
- Business software, including Dotpaper (below).

## Main pages

- [Ecocee home](https://ecocee.in/): What Ecocee does, how it works with clients, and how to start a project.
- [Dotpaper](https://ecocee.in/dotpaper): Customizable business software with Service Desk, Financials, Customers and Inventory applications in one connected workspace. Built around the customer's own workflow, with an option to self-host.

## Kode, the programming language

Kode is a statically typed, compiled language with expressive syntax and native performance, built for cloud software, backend systems and AI-assisted development. It is free and open source under the Apache-2.0 license. The compiler is written in Rust and produces native binaries. Kode is at version 0.3 and still early: read the status page before relying on it.

- [Kode on GitHub](https://github.com/ecocee/Kode): Source code, README, issues and releases.
- [Cheat sheet](https://github.com/ecocee/Kode/blob/main/docs/cheatsheet.md): The whole language on one page.
- [Language spec](https://github.com/ecocee/Kode/tree/main/docs/spec): Formal description of the language.
- [Examples](https://github.com/ecocee/Kode/tree/main/examples): Short programs, one idea each.
- [Status](https://github.com/ecocee/Kode/blob/main/docs/STATUS.md): What works today and the known gaps.
- [Roadmap](https://github.com/ecocee/Kode/blob/main/docs/ROADMAP.md): What is planned next.
- [Benchmarks](https://github.com/ecocee/Kode/blob/main/benchmarks/report.md): Method, numbers and the cases Kode still misses. Figures come from one development machine.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/ecocee/Kode/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Guidance for AI coding agents working with Kode.
